protocol.title: Options implied-volatility surface (near-ATM IV level + put-call skew) -> subsequent realized volatility: wrapper-free rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-65 (identical Spearman rank-IC statistic) but a different, on-charter signal source: the options *surface* (trade-tape IV) rather than the options *order-flow* tape; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the surface complement to EVAL-65 (options order-flow) and EVAL-70 (underlying perp order-flow) that is runnable pre-threshold; EVAL-57 tested the VRP surface only as a traded net-of-cost straddle, never as information content
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol surface from the real Deribit option trade tape: atm_iv = amount-weighted mean iv of near-ATM trades (|strike/spot-1|<=atm_band) over the trailing window; skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv) over the same trades; both forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with real iv + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network; carries its own pre-registered trade-tape IV floor

floor.note: EVAL-71 measures a trade-tape implied-vol surface signal, so it carries its own pre-registered floor (option trades / near-ATM trades / perp candles / span). This is NOT a weakening of the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is reused verbatim there.
